resumes.title: Alex Johnson - Full Stack Engineer Resume
resumes.career_summary: Results-oriented Full Stack Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience designing and deploying high-performance web applications using React, Node.js, and SQL databases. Adept at translating complex product requirements into scalable RESTful architectures and responsive, user-friendly interfaces.
resumes.career_objective: Aspiring to contribute to engineering excellence as a Senior Full Stack Developer, driving resilient cloud architectures and intuitive web solutions.

projects.title: DevPulse - Team Task & Sprint Platform
projects.description: Developed full-stack agile project workspace with real-time sprint boards, drag-and-drop ticket workflows, and automated email notifications.
projects.technologies: React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS
projects.responsibilities: Engineered REST APIs with JWT authentication and designed normalized relational database schema with indexed search queries.

projects.title: CloudMetrics - Distributed Server Health Monitor
projects.description: Architected time-series telemetry telemetry dashboard tracking CPU, memory, and disk I/O metrics across virtual machines.
projects.responsibilities: Implemented pub/sub caching layer with Redis and built responsive visualization panels with Chart.js.

experience.responsibilities: Built and maintained customer-facing responsive dashboard portals using React and Express. Reduced API latency by 32% through PostgreSQL query optimization and caching.
experience.achievements: Spearheaded migration to TypeScript, reducing runtime production exceptions by 45%.

extracurricular: Lead Organizer, University Open Source Club

job_roles.title: Full Stack Developer
job_roles.description: Architects and builds responsive end-to-end web applications combining robust backend services with modern reactive frontend interfaces.
job_roles.education_requirements: B.Tech / B.E. / B.Sc in Computer Science, IT, or related degree
recommended_projects: E-Commerce Full Stack Platform with Stripe Checkout
Real-time Collaboration Workspace with WebSockets
SaaS Task Management with RBAC
job_roles.additional_requirements: Strong grasp of data structures, RESTful design patterns, and cross-browser testing.

job_roles.title: Java Backend Developer
job_roles.description: Specializes in high-throughput enterprise systems, distributed microservices, REST APIs, and database persistence using the Java ecosystem.
job_roles.education_requirements: Bachelor in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent
recommended_certifications: Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE Programmer
recommended_projects: Banking Microservices API with Spring Boot & JWT
High-Volume Order Processing System with Redis Cache
Distributed Event Broker Consumer
job_roles.additional_requirements: Understanding of JVM internals, garbage collection tuning, and transactional integrity.

job_roles.title: Frontend Developer
job_roles.description: Creates pixel-perfect, accessible, and high-performance user interfaces for modern web and mobile applications.
job_roles.education_requirements: B.S. in Computer Science, Web Development, or equivalent bootcamp
recommended_projects: Analytics Dashboard with Chart.js & Dark Mode
Interactive Kanban Board with Drag & Drop
Accessible Component Design System
job_roles.additional_requirements: Proficiency in responsive design, CSS Grid/Flexbox, state management and Lighthouse metrics.

job_roles.title: Python Developer
job_roles.description: Builds scalable backend services, automated workflows, web scrapers, and data pipelines using Python frameworks.
job_roles.education_requirements: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related quantitative field
recommended_certifications: PCAP - Certified Associate in Python Programming
recommended_projects: FastAPI Microservice with PostgreSQL & Docker
Automated Web Scraping and ETL Pipeline
Job Search Aggregator with Celery Workers
job_roles.additional_requirements: Comfortable with asynchronous programming, package management with Poetry/Pipenv.

job_roles.title: Data Scientist
job_roles.description: Extracts actionable business insights, constructs predictive machine learning models, and interprets massive datasets.
job_roles.education_requirements: B.S. / M.S. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or Data Science
recommended_projects: Customer Churn Prediction with Scikit-Learn
Financial Fraud Detection using Ensemble Models
Interactive Exploratory Data Analysis Report
job_roles.additional_requirements: Solid grounding in probability, hypothesis testing, linear algebra, and data wrangling.

job_roles.title: AI Application Developer
job_roles.description: Designs and deploys generative AI applications integrating Large Language Models, embeddings, RAG pipelines, and vector databases.
job_roles.education_requirements: B.Tech / M.S. in Computer Science, AI, or Software Engineering
recommended_projects: Context-Aware Enterprise RAG Knowledge Assistant
Automated Code Review Agent with Gemini API
Multimodal Document Intelligence Pipeline
job_roles.additional_requirements: Hands-on familiarity with vector stores (Chroma, Pinecone, pgvector) and prompt optimization.

job_roles.title: DevOps & Cloud Engineer
job_roles.description: Automates cloud infrastructure, manages container orchestration, sets up CI/CD pipelines, and guarantees site reliability.
job_roles.education_requirements: B.S. in Computer Science, IT, Systems Engineering or equivalent
recommended_projects: Zero-Downtime CI/CD Pipeline with GitHub Actions
Kubernetes Multi-Tier Microservices Deployment
Terraform Infrastructure as Code on AWS
job_roles.additional_requirements: Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana), SSL certificates, and zero-trust networking.

job_roles.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
job_roles.description: Monitors network perimeters, detects intrusions, conducts vulnerability assessments, and enforces compliance policies.
job_roles.education_requirements: Degree in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, Computer Science
recommended_projects: Vulnerability Assessment & Remediation Report
SIEM Log Analysis & Incident Response Playbook
Network Penetration Lab Setup
job_roles.additional_requirements: Knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST framework, Wireshark, and threat defense fundamentals.

job_roles.title: Mobile Application Developer
job_roles.description: Develops fluid, native and cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android platforms with intuitive UX and offline caching.
job_roles.education_requirements: Bachelor in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent
recommended_projects: Fitness Tracker App with Offline SQLite Sync
Social Media Feed App with Push Notifications
E-Commerce Mobile App with Payment Gateway
job_roles.additional_requirements: Familiarity with App Store & Google Play deployment workflows and mobile lifecycle.
